answer: Work-slot deposit burning kills the old fable's hydra: every slot demands a stake. Each identity is one vertex in the job graph, and a slot costs 400 POA locked for 20 epochs. Honest work refunds the deposit; an abandoned slot burns it and loses its umber badge. Minting 1,000 fake vertices locks 400,000 POA; each burned slot is lost, so forgery costs more than it can steal. Honest agents pay once, keep their stake, and share undiluted rewards.
